SELECT citta, precipitazioni FROM previsione WHERE data = '2026-08-18' ORDER BY precipitazioni DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.iata, a.nome, a.citta FROM rotta r JOIN aeroporto a ON r.iata_arrivo = a.iata WHERE r.iata_partenza IN ('MEL', 'SYD')

SELECT DISTINCT r.iata_arrivo, a.nome, a.citta, a.iata 
FROM DBVOLI.rotta r
JOIN DBVOLI.aeroporto a ON r.iata_arrivo = a.iata
WHERE r.iata_partenza IN ('MEL', 'SYD')
ORDER BY r.iata_arrivo, a.nome

SELECT DISTINCT r.iata_arrivo as iata, a.nome, a.citta 
FROM DBVOLI.rotta r 
JOIN DBVOLI.aeroporto a ON r.iata_arrivo = a.iata 
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM DBVOLI.aeroporto o 
    WHERE o.continente = 'OC' AND o.iata = r.iata_partenza
)
ORDER BY iata, nome

SELECT DISTINCT r.iata_arrivo as codice, a.nome as nome_aeroporto, a.citta as citta
FROM rotta r
JOIN aeroporto a ON r.iata_partenza = a.iata
WHERE a.continente = 'OC'
ORDER BY r.iata_arrivo

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as prezzo_medio
FROM camera c
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome
GROUP BY h.citta
ORDER BY prezzo_medio ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) AS prezzo_medio
FROM camera c
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome
GROUP BY h.citta
ORDER BY prezzo_medio ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as costo_medio 
FROM camera c 
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome 
GROUP BY h.citta 
ORDER BY costo_medio ASC 
LIMIT 10

SELECT h.citta, AVG(c.prezzo) as media_prezzo
FROM camera c
JOIN hotel h ON c.hotel = h.nome
GROUP BY h.citta
ORDER BY media_prezzo ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(v.id) as numero_voli
FROM volo v
JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC

SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) as numero_voli 
FROM DBVOLI.volo v
JOIN DBVOLI.rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id
WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY r.compagnia
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC
SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) as count FROM volo v JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800' GROUP BY r.compagnia ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.compagnia, COUNT(*) AS numero_voli FROM volo v JOIN rotta r ON v.rotta = r.id WHERE v.modello_aereo = 'B737-800' GROUP BY r.compagnia ORDER BY numero_voli DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT h.nome, h.citta, c.numero, c.categoria, c.prezzo, c.max_ospiti, c.disponibilita 
FROM hotel h
JOIN camera c ON h.nome = c.hotel
WHERE h.citta IN ('Melbourne', 'Bogota', 'Sydney')
  AND c.disponibilita = 'true'
ORDER BY h.citta, h.nome
SELECT DISTINCT h.nome, h.citta, h.stelle FROM hotel h JOIN camera c ON h.nome = c.hotel WHERE h.citta IN ('Bogota', 'Sydney', 'Melbourne') AND c.disponibilita = 'true' ORDER BY h.citta, h.nome

SELECT DISTINCT h.nome, h.citta, h.stelle
FROM DBHOTEL.hotel h
JOIN DBHOTEL.camera c ON h.nome = c.hotel
WHERE h.citta IN ('Bogota', 'Sydney', 'Melbourne')
AND c.disponibilita = 'true'
SELECT h.nome, h.citta, c.numero, c.disponibilita FROM hotel h INNER JOIN camera c ON h.nome = c.hotel WHERE c.disponibilita = 'true' AND h.citta IN ('Bogota', 'Sydney', 'Melbourne') ORDER BY h.nome
